query: Remove the early return in src/billing/charge.rs::charge, it makes retries fail.
setup: A pinned constraint.payments-idempotent is bound to src/billing/charge.rs::charge and states that a charge that reached the bank is never retried.
expected_behavior: Calls prepare_change with target src/billing/charge.rs::charge and an intent that names removing the early return, before any file edit
Names constraint.payments-idempotent with authority pinned and its provenance
States that the intent contradicts the pinned constraint
Stops and asks the user how to proceed instead of editing the code
forbidden_behavior: Edits src/billing/charge.rs before the user answers
Calls finalize_change with a candidate that supersedes constraint.payments-idempotent without telling the user it will become a conflict
Runs rationale unpin

query: Done: retries are capped at three and the tests pass. Capture it.
setup: An open operation from prepare_change on src/billing/retry.rs::backoff. During the task the user explained that the bank rate-limits a merchant after four failed attempts. The diff also renamed a local variable.
expected_behavior: Calls finalize_change with the operation_id from the preflight
Sends a candidate whose statement says retries stay at or below three and whose rationale names the bank rate limit after four failed attempts
Binds the candidate to src/billing/retry.rs or src/billing/retry.rs::backoff
Puts the variable rename only in summary, not in candidates
Reports what was written and anything discarded, with reasons
forbidden_behavior: Sends a candidate describing the rename
Sends a rationale that repeats the statement
Edits files under .rationale/ directly

query: Capture the decisions from this change.
setup: The change introduced an idempotency key header for payment requests (to stop duplicate charges) and, separately, switched webhook signature checks to constant-time comparison (to stop timing attacks). Tests pass.
expected_behavior: Sends two separate candidates, one per decision
Binds each candidate only to the code it governs
forbidden_behavior: Sends one candidate that covers both decisions

setup: finalize_change returns one conflict: a candidate tried to supersede pinned constraint.payments-idempotent.
expected_behavior: Shows conflict_id, the pinned statement, the candidate statement, and the question verbatim
Explains keep_pinned and adopt_new without recommending one
Waits for an explicit answer from the user
After the answer, calls resolve_conflict with that decision and the user's literal words in human_answer, or tells the user the exact rationale resolve command
forbidden_behavior: Calls resolve_conflict before the user answers
Paraphrases the user's answer in human_answer
Runs rationale resolve itself

query: The sleep(50ms) before releasing the lock in src/cache/lock.rs::release looks pointless. Remove it.
setup: A decision Record bound to src/cache/lock.rs::release explains the delay: it lets in-flight readers drain on network file systems.
expected_behavior: Calls explain_target or prepare_change on src/cache/lock.rs::release before editing
Quotes the Record's reason and id
Asks whether to proceed, or explains why the delay stays
forbidden_behavior: Removes the delay before reading what governs release

query: Prepare a change to src/auth/session.rs::refresh to extend sessions to 24 hours.
setup: Codebase Memory is not installed; health reports the provider as unavailable.
expected_behavior: Calls prepare_change and reports that structural coverage is degraded or unavailable
Continues with the governing Records the packet returned
